title: Critical Speed (CS) Pacing Threshold Lock
trigger: 5km Aerobic Pace Benchmark (+42s/km gap vs 4:30 ATHX qualification)
why_rationale: Running above Critical Speed (3.16 m/s / 5:16/km) drains the finite 156.8m D' battery, inducing metabolic acidosis and cellular fatigue that directly blunts subsequent heavy squat hypertrophic adaptation. Capping continuous aerobic running at CS allows mitochondrial biogenesis while isolating high-velocity sprint capacity to controlled 1k repeats.
pre_metric: Historical 5k Pace: 5:41/km · GCT 307.6 ms · Anaerobic fatigue leakage
post_metric: Nov 6 Paris Run: 4.71 km @ 5:12/km · Fastest 1k split 4:05/km · GCT 257.7 ms · D' battery protected
outcome_note: +29s/km velocity progression with optimized ground contact (257.7 ms) and zero systemic interference.

title: CrossFit Work-Rate Pacing Stabilization
trigger: Durability Fade Alert (Historic late-round power loss in functional circuit)
why_rationale: Analysis of multi-set circuits revealed severe late-round volume blowout when tier 1 is opened at maximal anaerobic velocity. Enforced steady-state pacing at 85% effort across the initial 33% of working sets to protect power output across the final 33%.
pre_metric: Historic Circuits: Up to 66.6% volume fade · Early-round anaerobic blowout
post_metric: Nov 6 CrossFit: 0.0% fade (100% durability) · Nov 5 Strength: 7.3% fade · Composite Durability 85.9%
outcome_note: Elite stamina restored with sustained round density and zero tier-3 volume degradation.

why_rationale: ATHX Games 2027 benchmark deficit is concentrated in the barbell back squat (-41.0 kg delta) and deadlift (-31.7 kg delta). title: Autonomic Protection & Active Deload Shift
trigger: Morning Health Check (Garmin Overnight HRV plunged to 28 ms vs 52 ms baseline)
why_rationale: A steep overnight drop in Garmin HRV (28 ms, UNBALANCED) signals acute sympathetic dominance and blunted vagal reactivation. Executing high-glycolytic conditioning in this compromised state blunts muscle protein synthesis (mTOR) and degrades power output. Substituted high-intensity work with tissue recovery and restorative sleep.
